<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="welcome-to-suggestions" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Welcome to #suggestions</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Here, we welcome any suggestions you want to make on improving the server! See below for steps and tips on making suggestions.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="categories"><ins><nowiki>Categories</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Guide suggestion</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - Suggestions for guide content or structure (e.g. updated rotations, deleting a redundant section).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Server suggestion</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - Suggestions for server operations or structure (e.g. improvements to the vod review process, shifting of channels).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use </nowiki><span><nowiki>#modmail</nowiki></span><nowiki> for more sensitive topics.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Command suggestion</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - Suggestions about changing/introducing commands</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Typo Fix</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - Suggestions highlighting typos to be fixed</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Mastery/Feats</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - Suggestions about changing/introducing feats or masteries.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="making-suggestions"><ins><nowiki>Making suggestions</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Below outlines the process and suggested steps of making suggestions.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<ol><nowiki>
</nowiki><li><nowiki>Enter the title in the search bar and click </nowiki><strong><nowiki>&quot;New post&quot;</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></li><nowiki>
</nowiki></ol>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/19lrC0CzsW.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<ol><nowiki>
</nowiki><li><nowiki>Enter more details about suggestion (</nowiki><strong><nowiki>including pictures/vods can be very helpful</nowiki></strong><nowiki>) and mark your suggestion with relevant tags - $linkmsg_categories$</nowiki></li><nowiki>
</nowiki></ol>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/Alvvbay4ja.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<ol><nowiki>
</nowiki><li><nowiki>Include as many details as possible, including but not limited to:</nowiki></li><nowiki>
</nowiki></ol>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a. Why the suggestion is good.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎b. Possible limiting factors?</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎c. Alternative ways to implement your idea.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎d. Or even a mock-up of what it will look like once implemented.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/ynoKT4H2U6.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<ol><nowiki>
</nowiki><li><nowiki>If your suggestion thread involved a long discussion, you can provide a (point-form) summary once the discussion concludes to facilitate implementation.</nowiki></li><nowiki>
</nowiki></ol>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/P0hUew9MR9.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<ol><nowiki>
</nowiki><li><nowiki>If you see this message, it means an editor is working on implementing your suggestion! You can return to the thread to check on its progress in the future if you find that it's taking too long.</nowiki></li><nowiki>
</nowiki></ol>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a. </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Remember, the fastest way to implement your ideas is always to edit PvME directly!</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Visit &lt;id:customize&gt; and select Entry Editor</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/jfZMLxceyp.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<ol><nowiki>
</nowiki><li><nowiki>Use this link to leave suggestions </nowiki><strong><nowiki>anonymously</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - </nowiki>[https://forms.gle/2Q4fPrtsdCZkKEnf8 <nowiki>https://forms.gle/2Q4fPrtsdCZkKEnf8</nowiki>]</li><nowiki>
</nowiki></ol>
<nowiki>
      
    </nowiki>

</div>
